summary: 30-foot steel tower built 1931 at Dolly Sods (Plains), moved to Bell Knob by the Army in 1943. Plains site listed gone; footings photographed 2008.

facts.status_note: Moved to Bell Knob in 1943; no tower stands on the Plains site.

events.note: 30-foot steel tower completed at Dolly Sods (Plains) on the Potomac Ranger District for $2,019.50
Dismantled and moved several miles north to Bell Knob; the Army paid for the move
Photographs on the Plains register page show footings at the site, captioned September 2008
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register January 26, 2017; nominated by Brian M. Powell

corrections.why: The Plains record, Forest Lookouts and the Forest Service history all say the tower was moved to Bell Knob, where it still stands. Removed hides that the structure survives.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service history and the register coordinates put Bell Knob north of the Plains site (38.964 N against 39.000 N). One travel article says the move went south. The story follows the Forest Service account.

resolved_conflicts.field: built year for the Bell Knob structure
resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Bell Knob register page gives 1943 in its Built field, the year of the move. Its description and the Plains record give 1931 for the first build, so 1931 is the built year and 1943 the relocation.

notes_for_editor: Core history is well sourced (built 1931, moved 1943, four sources agree on both). Thin on today: the only physical evidence is a September 2008 photo caption showing footings at the Plains site; no source says what is there now or whether the ground is open to visitors. The Bell Knob structure has its own record and story; this story stops at the move and summarises its state only. Height 30 ft converted to 9.1 m; no source here gives a different height for the Plains tower. The us-wv-bell-knob.json file lists height_m current 3.0 in its corrections; 30 ft is about 9.1 m, so that correction should be checked.
